author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I experienced model collapse first hand.  (well... not exactly the model collpase, but close enough)

I have a skill (on Claude Code Sonnet 5) write a daily scrum report for my team, I haven't made any changes to the skill, but the daily scrum report slowly degrades, to a point that it is human unreadable.

I finally ask Claude Code to investigate, it turns out Claude use the previous reports as style reference.  After Claude feeding on its output for 3 months, the daily report degenerates into AI slop.

Now imagine if we have pure AI written code base, the AI use existing code as reference to modify the same code base, after some number of iterations, the whole code base will become AI slop.
